summary: REQ-1001 asks for the SignFlow Add-on (E-signature) at 800 USD/year for 3 users in Finance, with internal_documents access, no integrations and normal urgency. Finance has 29000 USD available (90000 budget, 61000 committed), so the request is within budget. SignFlow is already approved: the registry shows procurement, security (reviewed 2026-06-20) and legal terms all Approved, and vendor risk is low. A company-wide SignFlow agreement exists (SW010, 45 licensed seats, PO-2513, 16000 USD). evaluate_policy returned only the Manager approval, no risk flags, no missing information and the baseline label 'Proceed with standard approvals'. No instruction-like text was found in the request fields or tool outputs.
concerns: The existing company-wide SignFlow agreement (SW010, 45 licensed seats, covers the requester's department) may already cover the three additional signing identities. Whether the add-on is needed on top of the existing licence could not be confirmed from the tool results.
get_vendor_risk reports processes_personal_data: true for SignFlow. stores_data_outside_region is false. The request itself only declares internal_documents access.

overlap_assessment.reason: find_existing_software returned SW010 SignFlow (Approved, 45 licensed seats, Company-wide) matching on same_vendor, same_product and same_category, and it covers the requester's department. This is the same vendor's existing product, not a different vendor's overlapping tool, so no existing_tool_overlap flag is raised. The request is an add-on for additional signing identities under that approved relationship. Whether existing seats already cover the need is left to the reviewer.
